svg.title: All electronics on one carrier · 18 × 24 holes — bottom worksheet
svg.text: 18 columns × 24 rows A–X · 2.54 mm pitch · nominal outline 47.78 × 63.02 mm · not a drilling template
SOLDER SIDE — flip like a book; A1 right; keep the same physical hole names
SOLDER JOINTS · one number = one conductor
Keep Rbe.1 ≥ 9.62 mm; solder R1 / Q1 / Q2 / P2
Keep QP.E ≥ 7.08 mm; solder P2 / O2 / O1
Keep Rbe.2 ≥ 4.54 mm; solder R2 / R3
Keep QP.B ≥ 7.08 mm; solder P3 / Q3 / R3
Keep QP.C ≥ 7.08 mm; solder P4 / O4 / O5
Keep Rb.2 ≥ 7.08 mm; solder R7 / Q7 / P7
Keep QL.G ≥ 7.08 mm; solder P8 / Q8 / R8
Keep Rbtn.1 ≥ 7.08 mm; solder T8 / S8 / R8
Keep QL.S ≥ 7.08 mm; solder P9 / Q9 / R9
Keep Rgl.2 ≥ 7.08 mm; solder R9 / R10 / R11
Keep Rbtn.2 ≥ 9.62 mm; solder T4 / U4 / U5 / V5
Keep Db.A ≥ 7.08 mm; solder V1 / W1 / X1
Keep Rs1.2 ≥ 7.08 mm; solder X5 / X6 / X7
Solder windows only at X11 / V11 / U11 / T11 / S11 / R11 / G14 / E14 / C14 / C18 / E18
LEG: bend the existing component leg (bare silver). WIRE / BUS: add insulated wire.
Filled dots are solder joints, including intermediate pads; other crossed pads stay
unconnected. Squares mark pigtail attachment pads; see the modules sheet.
432 isolated pads · square = wire attachment · use all three carrier sheets
Isolated pads: only listed joints connect. OUT− is system ground; BAT− stays separate. Proposed layout; verify actual parts.
